canonical_definition: LIVE_ORDER_PLAN_OBSERVED is the fourth §11.14 Live proof-claim field. It is true iff a current Live canary order-plan artifact is produced on the productive submit path after refuse_submit_unless_gates_pass_v1 from current venue-derived inputs. Static builder presence, a blocked dry-run, and §11.13.4 LIVE_DRY_RUN_ORDER_PLAN_PROVEN are each insufficient. True does not imply LIVE_SUBMIT_ACK_OBSERVED or POST authorization by itself.
